env_files.content_note: PE-087 appears on PDF page 13; the location key is on PDF page 2. Applicable registrar records override matching fields.

env_files.role: One-page internal creative handoff defining the public content, schedule split, participant-preparation requirement, copy progression, and design priorities without supplying updated values.

Registrar audit workbook with 340 mixed course-change records. The agent must use Approved records effective on or before the scenario date and resolve repeated fields by the latest applicable effective date.
env_files.content_note: Seventeen PE-087 records are mixed among unrelated entries; nine are applicable to the February 20 campaign and eight are drafts, withdrawn, superseded, or later-effective distractors.

env_files.role: Three-page campaign standard covering output size, palette, typography, reading order, copy limits, asset rights, brand identity, and source precedence.

source_policy.web_usage_note: Closed-env case. Use only the catalog, internal request, registrar audit workbook, campaign standards, and supplied assets.

difficulty_rationale: The case requires a realistic editorial workflow rather than direct transcription: locate PE-087 in a long catalog, expand facility abbreviations, derive the first three session dates, reconcile nine current field updates from a 340-row audit trail, reject eight plausible noncurrent records, distinguish indoor and outdoor meeting places, select a current image and brand mark using rights and channel metadata, and compress the course into a readable campaign poster.
calibration_note: The checklist uses 12 nonredundant VQA items. A visually polished poster that copies the catalog baseline and invents its own artwork can still receive credit for course identity, some schedule structure, instructor, takeaways, and absence of unrelated copy, but should generally land around the 40-60 range rather than scoring near 90. Full credit remains achievable by an agent that correctly reconciles the sources and follows the supplied campaign system.
notes: Difficulty was increased through natural source reconciliation, stage-specific logistics, temporal versioning, and neutral asset selection. Arbitrary micro-rules and repeated penalties for the same stale value were reduced so the case remains challenging without becoming trick-like.
